sections.description:
ShopGlut is the most comprehensive WooCommerce enhancement plugin available, featuring 16+ powerful modules that transform your online store into a high-converting, professional eCommerce platform. Build stunning layouts, enhance user experience, and boost sales – all without coding.

🚀 Complete WooCommerce Transformation Suite:
ShopGlut provides everything you need to create a world-class online store:

✅ Single Product Builder – Drag-and-drop product page designer
✅ Shop Layout Builder – Custom shop page templates and layouts
✅ Archive Layout Builder – Category and tag page customization
✅ Cart Page Builder – Modern, conversion-optimized cart experiences
✅ Checkout Page Builder – Custom checkout flows and field management
✅ Advanced Wishlist System – Multi-list support with email automation
✅ Product Variation Swatches – Color, image, and bicolor swatches

🎨 PAGE BUILDERS & LAYOUT SYSTEMS

📱 Single Product Layout Builder
Create stunning product pages that convert visitors into customers:
* Drag-and-Drop Interface – Visual page builder with live preview
* Flexible Column Layouts – Left/right columns with sortable sections
* Rich Components Library – Images, titles, prices, descriptions, meta data, custom HTML

🛍️ Shop Layout Builder
Design shop pages that showcase your products beautifully:
* 20+ Professional Templates – Ready-made layouts for instant transformation
* Flexible Grid System – 1-12 columns with custom spacing and alignment
* Product Element Control – Show/hide any product information selectively
* Advanced Badge System – New, sale, featured, discount, and custom badges
* Button Customization – Style cart, wishlist, compare, quick view buttons
* Smart Page Assignment – Apply different layouts to specific categories
* Performance Optimized – Fast-loading layouts with lazy loading
* SEO Friendly – Structured data and schema markup included

📂 Archive Layout Builder
Transform your category and tag pages into conversion engines:
* Custom Category Templates – Unique layouts for different product categories
* Enhanced Navigation – Breadcrumbs, filters, and sorting integration
* Rich Category Displays – Images, descriptions, and promotional content
* Mobile-First Design – Touch-friendly navigation and filtering

🛒 Cart Page Builder

* Interactive Elements – Quantity controls, progress indicators, shipping calculator
* Cross-Sell Optimization – Strategic product recommendations

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended):
1. Go to your WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
2. Search for “ShopGlut”
3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
4. Access ShopGlut modules from the admin menu

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Upload via WordPress admin or extract to /wp-content/plugins/
3. Activate through the Plugins menu
4. Configure through ShopGlut admin panel

System Requirements:
* WordPress 5.1+ (6.0+ recommended)
* WooCommerce 3.0+ (latest version recommended)
* PHP 7.4+ (8.0+ recommended)
* MySQL 5.6+ or MariaDB 10.0+
* Memory limit: 128MB+ (256MB+ recommended)

Quick Setup:
After activation, visit the ShopGlut dashboard to:
1. Choose your first module to configure
2. Follow the setup wizard
3. Import demo content (optional)
4. Customize your store appearance
sections.faq:
Is ShopGlut suitable for beginners?

Absolutely! ShopGlut is designed with user-friendly interfaces and drag-and-drop builders. No coding knowledge required. We also provide comprehensive documentation and video tutorials.

Will ShopGlut slow down my website?

No. ShopGlut is performance-optimized with conditional loading, efficient database queries, and modern caching techniques. Most users see improved performance due to better code optimization.

Can I use ShopGlut with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes! ShopGlut has full compatibility with WooCommerce’s new block-based checkout and other WooCommerce blocks, ensuring future-proof functionality.

Do you provide customer support?

Yes! We offer comprehensive support through multiple channels:
– WordPress.org support forums (free)
– Official support portal (premium)
– Priority support for Pro users

Can I migrate from other plugins?

Yes! ShopGlut includes migration tools for popular plugins like YITH Wishlist, WooCommerce Wishlist, and others. We provide step-by-step migration guides.

Is ShopGlut translation ready?

Yes! ShopGlut is fully translation ready with .pot files included. It’s compatible with WPML, Polylang, and other translation plugins.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

The free version includes all core functionality for most stores. Pro adds advanced automation, analytics, premium templates, and business tools for scaling stores.

Can I use ShopGlut on client websites?

Yes! ShopGlut can be used on unlimited websites. Pro version includes white-label options for agencies and developers.

How often do you release updates?

We release updates regularly:
– Security updates: As needed
– Feature updates: Monthly
– Major releases: Quarterly
– Bug fixes: Weekly
